newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania central bank one-week refinancing funds up.
newsitem.headline: Romania central bank one-week refinancing funds up.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said it raised one-week refinancing funds on offer at Thursday's auction by 105 billion lei to 1.045 trillion lei.
Its one-week minimum permitted rate was flat at 50 percent.

Traders suggested that recent rises of BNR funds available amid a balanced money market might be intended to stimulate banks to drag more liquidity from the central bank and buy treasury-bills to help finance rising state budget deficits.
BNR officials were not immediately available for comment.
Last week, the central bank raised the amount of one-week funds on offer to 940 billion lei from 700 billion.
Short-term money market rates idled at 49-50 percent.
The eight-month state budget showed a gap of 1.9 trillion lei, while the forecast for the whole year is 4.27 trillion.
Auction results are expected on FXRP later on Thursday or early on Friday. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
